name: ledger-codex-gemini-usage-hardening
title: Harden codex/gemini usage capture: token-only projection + unavailable-final on malformed usage
description: A genuine Codex host-2 cross-review of merged story B-12d7 (VERDICT: FAIL) found two real correctness gaps the Claude-only review missed. (1) extractCodexUsage/extractGeminiUsage return the WHOLE provider usage sub-object verbatim, so a non-token key embedded inside `usage` (e.g. a transcript field) would survive into ProviderExecResult.reportedUsage, contradicting the 'numeric token fields only, never raw transcript' invariant the JSDoc claims. (2) recordDispatchFinalForProvider: when a usable-but-malformed usage object (e.g. prompt_tokens:-999) makes buildProviderRecord throw, the outer try/catch swallows it and the unavailable-final branch is skipped, so NO final is written and the preflight estimate is never superseded (orphaned) -- contradicting the design intent that garbage usage still writes an unavailable final that supersedes. This story hardens both, keeping the claude/anthropic path byte-identical, and extends the smoke to cover the cases that masked them.
